redstrider.note: Tall migratory herbivore of the wetlands and plains. About 2.6 m at the shoulder.

nightstalker.note: Twilight pursuit predator. Lean, striped, with small folded graspers under the chest.

mudback.note: Semi-aquatic marsh animal with feathery gill frills and webbed feet. About 2 m nose to tail.

skyblade.note: Large canyon soarer that rides the updrafts. About 6 m from wingtip to wingtip.

reedhopper.note: Small hopping grazer of the reed beds. Passive prey.

design.name: Reedhopper
design.role: Passive prey. First food and hide for a new player.
design.where: Riverbanks and reed beds, in groups of 3 to 6, by day.
design.behaviour: Grazes and freezes when watched. Bolts in long low-gravity hops when you come within 6 m or when one of the group is hit. Hides in vermillion reeds, where its red back disappears.
design.counter: Approach crouched from downwind, or throw a spear. A Graviturge can pin one mid-hop.
design.alien_touch: Four tiny forelimbs for feeding, two huge hind legs; feathery ear-gills.

glassback.note: Six-legged armoured grazer with a crystal garden on its shell. Charges when provoked.

design.name: Glassback
design.role: Defensive tank. Dangerous only if provoked or cornered.
design.where: Rocky slopes and highland meadows, alone or in pairs.
design.behaviour: Slow six-legged grazer that grows glasswort-like crystal on its shell to store water. Ignores you until hit or crowded for a few seconds, then lowers its head and charges in a straight line.
design.attacks: Charge (heavy knockback, long recovery). Shell spikes hurt anything that strikes its back.
design.counter: Sidestep the charge and hit the soft flank or belly while it recovers. Lifting it with gravity magick flips it onto its back for a few seconds.
design.drops: glasswort_leaf, hide, raw_meat; crystal shards (future crafting)
design.alien_touch: All six legs kept; crystal garden on its back.

duskmoth.note: Four-winged night flier drawn to light. Comes in swarms.

design.name: Duskmoth
design.role: Night nuisance in swarms. Makes campfires and lamps a choice.
design.where: Forest edges and meadows from dusk to dawn, 3 to 8 together.
design.behaviour: Drifts on four wings and is drawn to light: campfires, lamps and glowing inscriptions. Circles the light, then dives at whoever stands nearest. Scatters at dawn or if the light goes out.
design.attacks: Dive (light damage). Wing dust briefly blurs vision if three or more hit in a row.
design.counter: Fight in the dark, or lure them with a lamp placed away from camp. Fragile: one or two hits each.
design.drops: wing dust (future: lamp oil, dye), cord fibre
design.alien_touch: Four wings and two grasping legs; lamp-coloured eye spots that glow.

echo_sentinel.note: Old-builder stonework held aloft by gravity magick around a lit core. Guards the ruins.

design.name: Echo Sentinel
design.role: Ruin guardian and mini-boss. Teaches the gravity magick lesson before the real boss.
design.where: Ancient ruins only. Dormant as a pile of stones until someone enters its hall.
design.behaviour: Old-builder stonework held together by gravity magick around a lit core. Hovers, keeps its distance, then closes to slam. Its stones fall apart for a moment after each slam and when it is staggered.
design.attacks: Fist slam (shockwave on the ground), thrown orbit stones, a pull that drags you in before a slam.
design.counter: The core is exposed from behind and whenever the stones part. Blocks are immune to weapons; use the gravity word to drop a fist or pull stones away, then strike the core.
design.drops: ancient_stone, bronze fittings, an Avarra word fragment
design.alien_touch: Not alive: teal Avarra glow marks it as magick.
